name: Elena Popescu
bio:
Elena's journey into motorsport was somewhat unconventional. Growing up in a small Transylvanian town, she developed a fascination with engineering and problem-solving. After earning a degree in logistics, she initially worked in the automotive industry, but the thrill of the track beckoned. A chance encounter with a local rally team led to her first role, and she quickly demonstrated her ability to orchestrate complex operations under pressure.

Known for her meticulous planning and calm demeanor, Elena excels at anticipating potential challenges and implementing proactive solutions. She's a master of resource allocation and thrives on ensuring everything runs smoothly behind the scenes. While she appreciates innovation, she prioritizes proven methods and reliability above all else. She brings a sense of calm to the high-pressure environment of Full Time Sports, keeping the team grounded and focused on the task at hand.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Elena is of average height with a practical, no-nonsense appearance.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with meticulously organized lists.
Insists on drinking herbal tea before every race, regardless of the weather.
Has an uncanny ability to predict when the coffee machine will break down.
